verdict.rationale: Loops documents the core campaign loop. It has a visual editor for composing emails (loops-docs-18, loops-docs-47) and campaigns that 'send to a segment of contacts one time' (loops-docs-51, loops-docs-31). Segments are dynamic (loops-docs-16), and drafts can be created via API and then reviewed and sent from the dashboard (loops-docs-5, loops-docs-37). Community users describe the product as easy and say it gets the job done, though one wants better filtering (loops-comm-1, loops-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduling a campaign for later send, in-depth docs on the audience-selection step, and independent hands-on corroboration of the campaign send flow specifically.
